Nina Patel: heads up — saw a weird post-quantization regression on the new anamorph model when we resample rotary embeddings for longer contexts. repro below.

Mia Chen: can you drop the minimal repro and a failing assert? I'll try locally.

Nina Patel: repro (int4 quant, seq extend via resample):
```py
# run in bench env
out1 = infer(model='anamorph-v1', input=prefix, quant='int4', max_len=2048)
# resample rotary to 4096 and rerun with cached kv
model.resample_rope(4096)
out2 = infer(model, input=prefix, use_kv_cache=True)
# expect cached continuation to match cold run prefix tokens
assert out1.tokens[:20] == out2.tokens[:20]  # FAIL: token shift at position 1536
```

dev-qa-bot: nightly canary ran this on bench-shared, failing 8/12 runs; error snippet:
```
KVCacheMismatchError: kv_index 1536 != expected 1535
stack: runtime/infer/cache.py:412
```

Samir Gupta: hypothesis: resample_rope uses linear interpolation and float->int rounding causes phase slip at even-length boundaries. Seen similar with per-head quantized scales. Try forcing nearest-neighbor during resample.

Arpit Rao: pushed a small patch that clamps the roll index and rounds to nearest int: `resample_rope(..., rounding=\'nearest\', clamp=True)` — quick run shows 12/12 pass on bench for same test. ping @Mia for perf review.

Mia Chen: nice. can we add a synthetic fuzz test to CI that extends sequences past the original window boundary and compares cached vs cold runs? if so, add a small perf regression check for resample cost.

ModelBenchBot: Regression: perplexity delta +0.02 on small testset when clamp=False; clamp=True fixes. PR #2384 referenced.

Nina Patel: filing bug and marking as P0 for quant bring-up. I'll add the failing sample and logs to the ticket. thanks team :raised_hands:

Samir Gupta: I'll run a Dedicated canary tomorrow morning across GPUs; if stable we can cut a hotfix branch.

dev-qa-bot: scheduled canary: pipeline/canary/1745080000, notify #eng-oncall on failure.

Arpit Rao: added unit test and small doc comment about integer alignment; will attach to PR.

Mia Chen: leaving a note to review later today. :eyes:
